error_unit: Minimal connected discrepancy between aligned reference and OCR at character spans; adjacent/overlapping manifestations of same defect merged by independent adjudication. Keep original and derived coordinates separate. Token opportunity intervals use frozen versioned tokenizer selected in T52; unscorable segmentation stays unknown. Do not choose units after seeing which metric improves.
sampling_analysis: Primary totals use N_h/5; uncertainty respects five strata and paragraph clustering of token errors. Use finite-population sampling variance for totals when defined; state ratio uncertainty method before scoring. With5primary paragraphs/part or2confirmation/part, precision is weak; no corpus safety guarantee. Challenge counts have no weights. Confirmation uses its restricted conditional frame only.
missing_outcomes: For unit-level error incidence report lower weighted rate treating unresolved units as error-free and upper treating them as error-containing, without treating either as actual truth. Error-count/word-level bounds require finite specified opportunities; if unknown, bounds unavailable. Resolved-subset estimates labelled conditional on evaluability, not population recall.
proposed_pause_rule: Hold method recommendation on any independently confirmed consequential harmful edit; report unresolved harm/miss evidence and criteria disagreements. Zero observed events is not proof of absence; H1/H2 must agree criteria before acceptance scoring.
